legacy.evidence: Sourced 2026-08-28 in [moving-source-gravity-bounds](../../studies/moving-source-gravity-bounds.md) § aberration cancellation: Heaviside/Liénard–Wiechert electromagnetism and Carlip's general-relativistic calculation calibrate the absence of a first-order uniform-motion wake in those specified equations. For the minimal class this is also a theorem of the explicit equation ([Branch C](branch-c.md) § The control, eq. 2, even in \(\xi_\parallel\) at every order). Kept at conjecture because the claim's general requirement that acceleration or explicit boost violation is necessary overreaches those examples: the sourced result is a calibration, not a verdict on every preferred-medium equation
